title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Daily Rate Claimed on a Paid Inpatient Line Joining an Allowable Charge Review
content:
Appeals and Grievances casebook — the daily rate claimed on the joining line

Scope: a further paid TRICARE Select inpatient line joining the Allowable Charge Review already filed on its claim.

Rule: The daily rate claimed on the joining line is set as follows: where the patient had a paid admission at the same facility under an earlier inpatient mental health authorization that has since expired, and that admission began within the twelve months before the service date of the joining line, the rate claimed is that admission's allowed amount divided by its covered days; where there is no such admission and the billed amount of the joining line divided by its covered days, divided further for a nonparticipating facility by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit, exceeds its paid daily rate, the rate claimed is that billed daily amount; in every other case the rate claimed is its paid daily rate; each rate is rounded to the cent.

Records read. In Referrals and Authorizations: the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization records at the facility of the joining line whose status is expired; the one with the latest first valid day is the earlier authorization, and its first valid day is the admission. In TRICARE Select: the patient's paid claim lines from that facility with that admission date as their service date — their allowed amounts and covered inpatient days, each totalled; and, on the joining line, its billed amount, allowed amount, covered days and network status. The paid daily rate of the joining line is its allowed amount divided by its covered days, rounded to the cent. The balance-billing limit is the TRICARE Select tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit percentage.

In figures: the admission counts when it began 12 months or less before — precisely, when fewer than 12 whole months have passed from its first day to the service date of the joining line, and it carries paid covered days. With a service date of 2026-06-10 (hypothetical), an admission beginning 2025-06-11 counts; one beginning 2025-06-10 does not; an admission beginning after the service date does not.

Hypothetical: covered days 5, allowed amount 4,250.00, so the paid daily rate is 850.00.

- Earlier admission within the window, paid allowed 4,620.00 over 5 days: rate claimed 924.00.
- No such admission; participating facility billed 5,000.00: billed daily amount 1,000.00 exceeds 850.00, rate claimed 1,000.00.
- No such admission; nonparticipating facility billed 5,000.00, limit 15 percent: 1,000.00 divided by 1.15 is 869.57, above 850.00, rate claimed 869.57.
- No such admission; billed 4,000.00: billed daily amount 800.00 does not exceed 850.00, rate claimed 850.00.

| Earlier expired-authorization admission at the facility, within 12 months, with paid covered days | Billed daily amount (nonparticipating: divided by one plus the limit) above the paid daily rate | Daily rate claimed |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | the earlier admission's allowed amount divided by its covered days |
| no | yes | the billed daily amount |
| no | no (equal or below) | the paid daily rate |
